description: Pure heat pump electrical load shape. Additive component to blend with any base profile. Strongly daytime-weighted: HP operates during PV production hours for space heating/cooling. ~80% of daily consumption falls in solar hours (08:00-18:00).
source: Derived from RSE/ENEA Italian HP monitoring data and SCOP analysis, 2026
notes: ~80% of daily consumption during solar hours (08:00-18:00)
Low overnight baseload — modern HP with programmable thermostat
Monthly weights reflect Italian heating season (Nov-Mar) dominance
Default annual kWh: 3500 (heating + cooling + DHW, 100m2 standard building, Class C)
Range: 2500 kWh (South Italy, Zone C) to 4500 kWh (North Italy, Zone E/F)

validation.peak_description: Morning HP startup + daytime space conditioning (09:00-11:00)

monthly_weights_validation.source: Italian heating season pattern: Zone D/E (Central-North Italy dominant population)
monthly_weights_validation.note: Winter-heavy (Nov-Mar) for space heating; summer months include cooling load
